evals.name: Objective Assertion Evaluation & Visual Scorecard
evals.prompt: Evaluate frameworks/angular/skills/angular-enterprise-forms against its test suite in evals/evals.json and output a visual scorecard.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive evaluation report objectively grading all assertions with concrete evidence and emitting a visual scorecard.
assertions: Discovers target skill directory and validates presence of SKILL.md and evals/evals.json
Objectively grades each assertion with binary PASS/FAIL status without subjective appraisal
Cites concrete code fragments or file paths as supporting evidence for every assertion
Outputs structured visual evaluation scorecard with benchmark delta and quality score percentage

evals.name: Failure Diagnostics & Remediation Prescription
evals.prompt: Run an evaluation on a skill where an assertion fails due to a missing Gotcha, and prescribe remediation.
evals.expected_output: Grading report marking the assertion as FAIL with specific diagnostic failure rationale and concrete SKILL.md remediation instruction.
assertions: Accurately flags failed assertions without false positives or silent passes
Computes quality score percentage deterministically from passed assertions ratio
Prescribes actionable remediation instruction pointing to SKILL.md or Gotchas section
Emits or updates evals/grading.json complying with the grading JSON schema
